warnings: 3 support images, one per class; 9 visually selected natural-background query images.
Dataset labels are not independently verified agronomic diagnoses.
Queries have garden/pot/field-like backgrounds, not a verified commercial-field dataset.
COCO-pretrained YOLO11n is a control, NOT the untrained/unavailable SOLO object detector.
YOLO class labels are ignored, which does not make its proposals class agnostic.
Reference boxes are evaluation-only, including the marked oracle-ROI diagnostic.
Known-three-class top1 matching; no calibrated unknown/background rejection.
Annotation incompleteness means unmatched proposals are not all proven false positives.
No weights or feature-fusion layers are trained. Query DINO forward only once/model.
timing_notes: CPU FP32, feature/SAM threads=4; actual YOLO threads recorded per sample. Unwarmed exploratory service timings, not a throughput benchmark.

manifest.attribution: Singh, Jain, Jain, Kayal, Kumawat & Batra, PlantDoc (2020)
selection_notes: Support uses cropped train images; queries use full TEST images.
Images selected visually for natural backgrounds and visible attached leaves, not model output.
Excluded white-background stock images, collages, slide text, detached cut leaves and suspected label/species mismatches.
The healthy support candidate Bacterial-leaf-spot-transplants1.jpg visibly has spots despite its folder; excluded.
Labels are dataset labels, not independent agronomic diagnoses; originals include garden, pot and field-like scenes, not all commercial fields.
No identical SHA256 or source filename between support and query. Not a guarantee of independent plant identities.

matching_feature: final LayerNorm patch tokens; fractional mean ROI pooling
support_pooling: whole support image; mean normalized support embeddings per class
proposal_matching: maximum count of IoU>=0.5 one-to-one pairs, then maximum total IoU
